title: BankAccount
description: A bank account linked to a Moov account as a funding source for ACH and RTP transfers.

bankAccountID.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

routingNumber.description: ABA routing transit number for the bank.

lastFourAccountNumber.description: Last four digits of the bank account number.

status.description: Verification and usability status of the bank account.

verificationStatus.description: Current state of the bank account verification process.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bank account was linked.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bank account was last updated.
